(467)༄༅/ /dzam bha la ser po'i khrid dngos grub char 'bebs bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (467)༄༅// dzam bha la ser po'i khrid dngos grub char 'bebs bzhugs so//

(568)༄༅// tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho yongs su rdzogs pa'i mthus// 'gro la dgos 'dod char chen rtag 'bebs pa// dge ba'i lo tog 'bras bu smin mdzad pa'i// chu dbang mgon po'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// gang la gsol ba btab pas skad cig la// bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs pa kun// 'bad med lhun gyis grub par stsol mdzad pa'i// bcom ldan dzaṃ bha la des bdag skyongs shig /de nyid man ngag bsgom pa'i rim pa rnams// snyan brgyud dgos 'dod kun 'byung gdams pa mchog /'gro la phan phyir yi ger bkod pa la// bla ma mkha' 'gro dzaṃ lhas byin gyis rlobs// 'dir 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la'i khrid dngos grub char 'bebs zhes bya ba 'di la don gsum ste/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes dang gsum mo// dang po la gsum ste/ bla ma brgyud pa'i byung tshul/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro/ khyad par gyi sngon 'gro dang gsum mo// dang po ni/ (469)rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi tra dz+wo ki de nyid/ dur khrod so sa gling du thugs dam lha lnga bsgrubs pas/ grub pa brnyes te/ lha so so'i zhal bstan nas/ khrid kyi rim pa rnams gnang zhing*/ mi rabs bdun gyi bar du byin gyis rlob par lung bstan/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa dzam bha la'i khrid 'di dag nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams la/ dgos 'dod char ltar bdag gis 'bebs shing*/ phyi ma'i mthar thug gi bar bdag gis dgos 'dod bsgrub par bya'o// yongs su bsrung zhing bde legs dang ldan par 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs nas bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid kyi rim pa gsungs so// rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mi tras rjes su bzung ba ni/ paṇa chen shrī pu tra'o// de nyid kyis rjes su bzung ba ni/ mtshungs med gīrti rat+na'o// gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba bsgom pa dang*/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgom pa dang*/ las rgyu 'bras kyi (470)don bsgom pa dang*/

'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgom pa ni spyi dang mtshungs so// gsum pa la bzhi ste/ dang po ci byas byang chub kyi lam du 'gro ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi khrid ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che du ma las kun nas grub pa'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che la bla ma rgya mtshos bskor ba/ mdun du yi dam/ g.yas su sangs rgyas/ rgyab tu dam chos/ g.yon du dge 'dun rgya mtshos bskor bar bsam la skyabs su 'gro bya/ mthar skyabs gnas rang la bstim la mi dmigs par bzhag go /gnyis sdig sgrib dag byed rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas ni spyi dang mthun no// gsum pa chad/ mchan/ bzhi pa byin rlabs myur du 'jug par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid ni/ spyi bor rin po che'i khri dang pad zla'i steng du rang gi rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam/ sangs rgyas/ chos/ dge 'dun/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong kun 'dus su bsgom la/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ dgos 'dod char ltar 'beb par gsol ba btab/ dbang bskur rnam gsum zhu/ mthar bla ma rang la bstims/ ma bcos pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /sngon 'gro 'di dag rgyas par mi tra'i khrid lnga ltar ro// dngos gzhi la gnyis te/ bskyed rim gyi khrid rdzogs rim gyi khrid do// dang po la gnyis te/ bskyed rim dang bzlas pa'o// dang po bskyed rim la yang gsum ste/ dang po bsnyen pa'i khrid ni/ gnas dben zhing nyams dga' bar/ tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi la gnas pas/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las/ sa gzhi rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ rgyan rta babs bang rim (471)bzhi pa/ chos 'khor gdugs tog dang bcas pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng nor bu'i tog gis mtshan pa/ lcags ri dang lcog gis bskor ba/ rdo rje'i phreng ba dang*/ skyed mos tshal gyi nang du bkra shis rtags brgyad/

rgyal srid sna bdun gyis bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su/ rin po che du ma las kun nas grub pa'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba/ rin po che sna lnga bkang ba'i bum bsnol gyis brgyan pa/ de'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma 'bum ldan/ a las nya rgyas pa'i zla ba'i steng du nor bdag ser po gan rkyal du 'gyel ba'i steng du/ dzaṃ yig gser gyi mdog can las dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer sna lnga phyogs bcur 'phros phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad mchod pa'i sprin phung gis mchod/ sems can thams cad la phog pas ser sna la sogs pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las dzaṃ las bī dza pu ra dzaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid dzaṃ bha la sku mdog gser btso ma'i mdog 'od 'bar ba/ zhabs gnyis rgyal po ral pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ dar sna tshogs kyis smad g.yogs can/ gser gyi sku rags la lte ba nor bus mtshan pa bcings pa/ sus khyim che zhing yan lag dang lhu tshigs rgyas pa/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin pus mo'i steng du mdzad nas shing thog pañca pu ra ka'i lte ba yid bzhin nor bu 'od 'bar bas mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas rin po che sna tshogs skyugs pa'i ne'u le 'dzin cing*/ zhal cung zad khro zhing yid tsam 'dzum pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar rab (472)tu rgyas pa/ dbu skra rol pa'i thor cog gyen la bcings shing*/ lhag ma thur du 'phyang ba/ me tog gi phreng bas skra chings dang*/ yid bzhin nor bu 'od 'bar ba lnga'i rtse bran gyis brgyan pa/ rin po che du mas snyan cha dang mgul rgyan/ dpung rgyan dang phyag gdub/ rkang rgyan dang zhabs gdub/ ut+pal sna lnga'i phreng ba bzang po 'phyang ba/ mu tig sna lnga'i phreng ba dang*/ dar gyi cod pan gyis mdzes pa/ 'od zer sna lnga'i phreng bas bskor ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/

pad+ma 'dab brgyad la nor bdag brgyad la rang lta bu'i cha lugs kyis bzhugs pa/ gzhan yang 'khor lha dang klu/ gnod sbyin/ dri za/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ srin po/ nor lha la sogs pa'i tshogs du mas bskor ba'i bdag nyid du bsam la/ de dag rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po las 'od 'phros/ lcang lo can nas rang lta bu'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dbyer med du bstim/ slar 'od 'phros/ rigs lnga spyan drangs/ dbang bskur/ sdig sgrib dag /bdud rtsi'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin 'byung la sogs pa rigs lngas dbu brgyan par bsam la/ thugs kar pad zla'i steng du/ nor bu dzaṃ ser pos mtshan pa/ de la yi ge bcu pa bsam la/ spyi bor oṃ/ dpral bar dzaṃ/ lce la bha/ mgrin par la/ snying khar dza/ lte bar len/ brla g.yas pa la dra/ g.yon pa la ye/ rkang pa g.yas su swā/ g.yon du hā/ zhes pa'i sngags rnams pad zla'i steng du/ dmar ser 'od 'bar ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'od zer gyi rtser 'phags pa'i (473)sku re re bzhugs shing*/ de dag rnams kyi phyag na rin po che dang ne'u le las rin po che sna lnga'i char babs par bsam la bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye swā hā/ zhes pa'i bsnyen pa bskyal ba'i tshe/ sngags rnams las 'od 'phros/ phyi snod la phog /gzhal yas khang du byas/ nang bcud la phog /dzaṃ bha lar byas/ thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags kyi sgra sgrog cing*/ rin po che sna lnga'i char chen po babs par bsam la snying po 'dren no// mthar snod bcud rang la bsdu/ rang sa bon la bsdu/ de dmigs med kyi ngang la bzhag go /gnyis pa rigs lnga la brten nas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi stobs rgyas par byed pa'i khrid ni/ rang gi bsnyen pa'i dus kyi ltar dzaṃ bha lar bskyed pa'i spyi bor pad zla'i steng du/ rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas 'khor lo thugs kar 'dzin pa/

g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dku la brten pa'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du nor bu dkar po oṃ yig dkar pos mtshan pa/ mgrin par pad zla'i steng du 'od dpag med dmar po g.yas pad+ma thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dku la brten pa'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du nor bu dmar po hrīḥs mtshan pa/ snying khar pad zla'i steng du mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dku la brten pa'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du nor bu sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ lte bar pad zla'i steng du rin chen 'byung ldan ser po/ g.yas nor bu thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dku la brten pa'i thugs (474)kar pad zla'i steng du nor bu ser po trāṃ gyis mtshan pa/ gsang gnas su pad zla'i steng du don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang khu g.yas rgya gram thugs kar gtod de 'dzin pa/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dku la brten pa'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du nor bu ljang khu āḥs mtshan pa/ thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung mdzad pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha lugs can du bsgom pa'i yid bzhin nor bu sa bon dang bcas pa lnga las/ 'od zer dkar dmar sngo ser ljang khu lnga 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod/ mchod pas mnyes par byas nas/ de dag gi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las ye shes lnga bsod nams kyi stobs thams cad 'od zer dkar dmar sngo ser ljang khu lngar bsdus nas/ rang gi gnas lnga'i thugs ka'i nor bu dang sa bon la thim pas/ rang nyid bsod nams dang ye shes kyi stobs rgyas par bsam la rlung bum pa can bzung ngo*// slar yang 'od zer dkar dmar ser ljang khu lnga 'phros/

rigs drug gi sems can la phog /de dag rnams kyi 'dod chags/ zhe sdang*/ gti mug /nga rgyal/ phrag dog /lnga sbyangs/ rigs lnga'i go 'phang la bkod/ de dag gi tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang grags pa stobs dang gzi brjid 'od zer dkar dmar sngo ser ljang khu'i dbyibs su bsdus nas/ rang gi gnas lngar thim/ rang gi tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang grags pa/ stobs dang gzi brjid thams cad rgyas par bsam la rlung bum pa can bzung ngo*// (475)slar yang gnas lnga'i nor bu dang sa bon las 'od zer lnga 'phros/ gzugs khams kyi lha'i nor bu dang*/ 'dod khams kyi lha dang*/ lha min/ klu/ gnod sbyin/ dri za/ mi'am ci/ mi rnams kyi nor bu dang*/ mdor na nyi zla'i 'od dang*/ 'byung ba lnga'i bcud dang*/ bkrag dang gzi mdangs yon tan thams cad 'od zer lngar bsdus nas/ gnas khang dang*/ yul 'khor thams cad du'ang rin po che dang longs spyod kyi char chen po babs par bsam la rlung bum pa can du bzung*/ de la rtsa 'khor lnga la dmigs thebs gsum re rdzogs par bya'o// rgyas par bsgom na rtsa 'khor re re la dmigs thebs re re bya ste/ dmigs thebs lnga'o// sbyor ba 'dis ni bsod nams kyi stobs rgyas shing*/ longs spyod kyi char chen po 'bab par 'gyur ro// 'od zer gyi sna la lha bsgom pa ni zhal las shes so// gsum pa zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sgo nas dmigs yul dbang du byas pa'i sbyor ba ni/ rang nyid dzaṃ bha la sngar bsnyen pa'i dus ltar bskyed pa'i gnas lngar/ rang lta bu'i dzaṃ bha la rigs lnga ni/ spyi bor rnam snang dzaṃ bha la dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma'i dzaṃ bha la dmar po/ snying gar rdo rje'i dzaṃ bha la sngon po/ lte bar rin 'byung dzaṃ bha la ser po/ gsang gnas su don grub dzaṃ bha la ljang khu rnams/ rin po che'i khri dang*/ pad zla'i steng na rang lta bu'i cha lugs kyis bzhugs pa'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du/

nor bu dkar dmar sngo ser ljang khu lnga gnas par bsgom/ de la dang po zhi ba'i sgo nas dbang du bya ba ni/ spyi bor rnam snang dzaṃ bha la'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du yid (476)bzhin gyi nor bu dkar po 'od 'bar ba las/ 'od zer dkar po zhags pa dang lcags kyu'i dbyibs can dpag tu med pa 'phros/ grub pa thob pa dang*/ mkha' la spyod pa dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ gnas lnga rig pa'i mkhas pa rnams dang*/ mdor na bla ma thams cad kyi smin mtshams su phog /thugs rgyud mnyes shing bde bas gang nas/ rang dbang med par spyi bor bkug nas/ bla ma dbang du 'dus nas bdag la rab tu mnyes shing rang rgyud sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa bsam pa ni bla ma dbang du bya ba'o// gnyis pa yi dam dbang du bya ba ni/ 'od zer dkar po zhags pa dang lcags kyu lta bu des/ yi dam gyi thugs kar reg pas/ yi dam thugs rgyud bde gsal gyis gang zhing*/ thugs brtse ba chen po dang ldan pas rang dbang med par byon nas/ rang gi spyi bo'i nor bu la thim pas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thob par bsam pa ni yi dam dbang du bya ba'o// gsum pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sogs pa btsun pa dbang du bya ba ni/ 'od zer dkar po lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu des/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi spyi bor phog nas/ rang dbang med par bkug cing spyi bo'i nor bu la thim par bsam pas btsun pa dbang du 'gyur ro// bzhi pa rgyal po dbang du bya ba ni/ 'od zer dkar po zhags pa dang lcags kyu lta bu des/ rgyal po'i thod pa la sogs pa spyi bor phog ste dzaṃ bha lar byas/ rang dbang med par bdag la dga' zhing mdun du 'dus nas/ spyi bo'i nor bu la thim par bsam mo// lnga pa blon po la sogs pa mi skye dbang du bya ba ni/ 'od (477)zer dkar po lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu des/ blon po la sogs pa rnams kyi snying nas bzung ste/

bdag la bdun pa dang*/ dad pa dang*/ dga' ba dang bcas nas rang dbang med par dbang du 'dus nor bu la thim par bsam mo// drug pa btsun mo la sogs pa'i bud med dbang du bya ba ni/ 'od zer dkar po zhags pa dang lcags kyu lta bu des/ btsun mo dang bud med rnams kyi lte ba dang pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru nas bzung zhing rang dbang med par bdag la dga' bzhin du dbang du 'dus nas spyi bo'i nor bu la thim par bsam mo// bdun pa longs spyod dbang du bya ba ni/ spyi bo'i nor bu sa bon dang bcas pa las/ 'od zer dkar po zhags pa dang lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ 'jig rten khams kyi nor bu thams cad dang rin po che sna lnga/ 'bru thams cad dang*/ gos thams cad/ zas thams cad/ nor zhing yul gru thams cad 'od zer gyis bsdus nas nor bu la thim par bsam mo// brgyad pa thams cad dbang du bya ba ni/ spyi bo'i dzam+bha la'i thugs kha'i nor bu las/ 'od zer dkar po zhags pa dang lcags kyu lta bu 'phros nas/ bla ma dang rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad la phog /mchod pas mnyes par byas/ sems can thams cad la phog pas dzaṃ bha lar byas/ phyi snod la phog pas rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnam par dag par sbyangs/ de nas de dag thams cad 'od zer gyis bsdus nas spyi bo'i nor bu la thim par bsams pas thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro// las tshogs brgyad po thams cad kyi thog mar rlung ro lan (478)gsum bus la/ ser sna la sogs pa'i sgrib pa lnga dag par bsam/ rlung tshur 'dzin pa'i tshe/ bsgrub bya de dag 'od zer dkar po/ lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bus/ gnas so sor phog pa'i tshe/ de dag gi lus sems thams cad dga' ba dang bde ba chen pos khyab cing*/ rang la dad pa dang*/ mos pa dang*/ brtse gdung drag po dang bcas nas rang dbang med par mdun du 'dus nas/ thams cad rnam snang dzaṃ bha lar gyur te mdun du 'khod pa la/

slar yang 'od zer gyis reg pa tsam gyis/ thams cad 'od dkar po zhu nas spyi bo'i dzaṃ bha la'i thugs ka'i nor bu la thim pa'i tshe/ spyi bo'i dzaṃ bha la'i nor bu dang phyag mtshan las dgos 'dod kyi longs spyod char chen po babs pas/ lus kyi nang dang rang gi gnas thams cad gang bar bsam la rlung bzung*/ de ni zhi ba'i sgo nas dbang du byed pa'o// gnyis pa dbang gi sgo nas dbang du byed pa ni/ rang nyid dzaṃ bha lar gnas pa'i mgrin pa/ rin po che'i khri dang*/ pad zla'i steng du/ rang lta bu'i dzaṃ bha la dmar po'i snying gar nor bu dmar pos mtshan pa las 'od zer dmar po zhags pa dang lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ bla ma la phog nas dbang du bya ba dang gcig /yi dam dang gnyis/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang gsum/ rgyal po dang bzhi/ blon po la sogs mi skya dang lnga/ btsun mo la sogs bud med dang drug /nor rdzas la sogs longs spyod dang bdun/ mdor na thams cad dbang du bya ba dang brgyad de/ sngar ltar so so'i gnas la phog pas/ lus sems thams cad dga' ba dang bde ba chen pos (479)khyab cing*/ rang la dad pa dang mos pa dang*/ brtse gdung drag po dang bcas nas/ rang dbang med par dbang du 'dus te pad+ma'i dzaṃ bha lar gyur nas mdun du 'khod pa la/ slar yang 'od zer gyis reg pas/ dga' ba chen po skyes nas/ 'od phung dmar por ltems gyis zhu nas mgrin pa'i pad+ma'i dzaṃ bha la'i snying kha'i nor bu la thim pas/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub rnam gnyis thob cing*/ rang gi lus kyi nang dang*/ gnas thams cad du yang longs spyod sna tshogs kyi char chen po babs par bsam la rlung bzung ngo*// de ni dbang gi sgo nas dbang du byed pa'o// gsum pa rgyas pa'i sgo nas dbang du bya ba ni/ rang nyid dzaṃ bha lar gnas pa'i lte bar/ rin po che'i khri pad zla'i steng du/ rin 'byung dzaṃ bha la rang lta bu snying khar pad zla'i steng du/

nor bus ser po dzaṃ ser pos mtshan pa las/ 'od zer ser po zhags pa dang lcags kyu lta bur phyogs bcur 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma la sogs thams cad la phog ste/ sngar ltar rang dbang med par dbang du 'dus nas/ rin 'byung dzaṃ bha lar gyur te mdun du 'khod pa la slar yang 'od zer gyis reg pas/ dga' bde chen po skyes nas 'od kyi phung po mer gyis zhu nas/ lte ba'i rin 'byung dzaṃ bha la'i lte ba'i nor bu la thim pas/ mchog thun mong gnyis kyi dngos grub thob cing lus kyi nang dang*/ gnas khang thams cad longs spyod kyi char chen po babs nas gang bar bsgom nas rlung bum pa can bzung ngo*// de ni rgyas pa'i sgo nas dbang du byed pa'o// bzhi pa drag po'i sgo nas dbang du bya ba ni/ rang nyid dzaṃ bha lar gnas pa'i gsang (480)gnas su/ rin po che'i khri pad zla'i steng du las kyi dzaṃ bha la ljang nag gam/ nag po'i snying gar pad zla'i steng du nor bu ljang khu dzaṃ nag pos mtshan pa las 'od zer ljang nag zhags pa dang lcags kyu lta bu phyogs bcur 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma sogs thams cad la phyogs pas/ dbang du bya ba rnam pa brgyad de/ sngar ltar so so'i gnas la phog pas/ lus sems thams cad dga' bde chen pos khyab cing*/ khyad par bsgrub bya thams cad skrag cing 'dar ba dang*/ sngangs pa dang*/ rmongs pa bcas nas/ rang dbang med par dbang du 'dus te/ las kyi dzaṃ bha lar gyur te mdun du 'khod pa las/ slar 'od zer gyis reg pas/ dga' bde chen po skyes nas 'od ljang khu'i phung por mer gyis zhu ste/ gsang gnas kyi dzaṃ bha la'i snying kha'i nor bu la thim pas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thob cing*/ lus kyi nang dang*/ rang gi gnas thams cad na longs spyod sna lnga'i char chen po babs pas gang bar bsam la rlung bum pa can bzung ngo*// de ni drag po'i sgo nas dbang du bya ba'o// lnga pa las sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas dbang du bya ba ni/

rang nyid dzaṃ bha lar gnas pa'i snying khar rin po che'i khri pad zla'i steng du mi bskyod pa dzaṃ bha la sngon po rang lta bu'am/ yang na dzaṃ bha la nag po khros par bsgom kyang rung gsungs/ de'i snying khar pad zla'i steng du/ nor bu sngon po dzaṃ sngon pos mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer dkar po dang dmar po sngon po ser po ljang gu sna tshogs te/ kha dog sna lnga/ zhags pa dang lcags kyu'i dbyibs can dpag tu med pa phyogs bcur 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma rnams dang*/ yi (481)dam thams cad de bsgrub bya brgyad la sogs pas/ dbang du bya ba rnam pa brgyad de/ sngar ltar de dag so so'i gnas la phog pas/ lus sems thams cad dga' bdes khyab cing*/ rang la byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ dad mos brtse gdung drag po dang bcas nas/ rang dbang med par dbang du 'dus shing mi bskyod pa dzaṃ bha lar gyur te mdun du 'khod par/ slar 'od zer sna lngas reg pas dga' bde chen po skyes nas/ 'od kyi phung po sngo mer gyis song bar bsam/ de dag 'od zer kha dog sna lnga'i rang bzhin du zhu nas snying kha'i dzaṃ bha la'i snying kha'i nor bu la thim pas/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub rnam gnyis thob cing*/ lus kyi nang dang gnas khang thams cad du rin po che sna lnga dang longs spyod kyi char chen po babs pas gang bar bsam la rlung bum pa can du bzung ngo*// de ni las sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas dbang du bya'o// 'di dag gi skabs su 'od zer gyi rtse la lha bsgom pa ni zhal la yod cing*/ nor bdag brgyad lus la bkod pa yang zhal las shes so// gnyis pa bzlas pa gsung gi khrid la gsum ste/ phyi nang gsang gsum mo// dang po ni/ rang nyid dzaṃ bha lar gnas pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ dpral bar dzam/ dpung pa g.yas pa bha/ g.yon du la/ snying khar dza/ lte bar len/ brla g.yas pa la dra/ g.yon du ye/ bol g.yas la swā/ g.yon la hā bskyed do// de dag gi 'od 'phros pa'i rtser/

yi ge bcu pa las rin po che sna lnga'i char babs par bsam la sngags 'dren no// gnyis pa ni/ rang nyid dzaṃ bha la sngar ltar gsal (482)ba'i gnas lngar/ dzaṃ bha la rigs lnga'i snying khar nor bu lnga dzaṃ lngas mtshan pa las/ sngags kyi kha dog de lta bu lnga 'khor bar dmigs nas sngags 'dren no// gsum pa ni/ rang nyid dzaṃ bha lar gsal ba'i gnas lngar dzaṃ bha la rigs lnga'i snying khar pad zla'i steng du/ nor bu dzaṃ rigs lngas mtshan pa lnga las/ sngags phreng kha dog sna lngas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ 'od zer gyi rtse la dzaṃ bha la rigs lnga 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad dzaṃ bha la rigs lngas them 'gags su gang*/ phyir 'phros/ ba spu'i rtsa ba thams cad kyi dzaṃ bha las gang*/ snod kyi 'jig rten la phog /sangs rgyas kyi zhing du byas/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad la phog pas thams cad dzaṃ bha lar byas/ 'od zer gyis bar snang gang zhing*/ 'od zer de dag gi rtse la dzaṃ bha la rigs lnga bzhugs nas thams cad kyi zhal nas sngags sgra di ri ri snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bcas nas bgrangs pas/ rin po che sna lnga dang longs spyod kyi char chen po babs par bsam la yid kyis bzlas pa bya'o// de ni gsang ba'i bzlas pa'o// de dag gis bzlas pa gsung gi khrid song*/ gnyis pa rdzogs rim gyi khrid la gsum ste/ zhi gnas/ lhag mthong*/ 'pho ba ste gsum mo// gong ma gnyis po ni spyan ras gzigs lam rim dang 'dra bar 'dug pas 'dir ma bris/ gsum pa 'pho ba ni/ rang nyid dzaṃ bha la bsgom pa'i spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying kha/ lte ba/ gsang gnas lngar/ dzaṃ bha la rigs lnga bskyed la/ gsang gnas kyi dzaṃ bha la thig le ljang khur gyur nas lte ba'i dzaṃ bha la la thim/ de thig le ser por gyur (483)nas snying kha'i mi bskyod pa la thim/ de thig le sngon por gyur nas mgrin pa'i snang ba mtha' yas la thim/ de thig le dmar por gyur nas spyi bo'i rnam par snang mdzad la thim/

de thig le dkar po 'od 'phro bar gyur nas spyi bo nas rgyangs kyis thon nas/ spyi bor bla ma rin 'byung du bsgom pa'i thugs kar thim/ de nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon sna lnga gyur nas/ 'od dang 'ja' tshon gyis nam mkha' gang bar bsam la/ dmigs med phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /de ni 'pho ba 'ja' tshon ma zhes bya ste sbyang ba dang las sbyor stabs su'o// des khrid kyi dngos gzhi song nas/ gsum pa rjes ni/ bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis rgyas 'debs bya zhing dus rgyun du nyams su blangs pas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub lhun 'grub tu 'byung bar 'gyur ro// khrid 'di ni rgyud pa 'dzin pa dang*/ snod dang ldan nges pa ma gtogs pa snod min la mi sbyin pa'i bka' rgyas btab bo// gang zhig dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i yid bzhin nor// gang gi gdams pa dngos grub gnyis 'byung ba// gang de bla ma'i drin gyis legs mthong bas// gang gang 'gro la phan phyir yi ger bkod// dge bas 'gro kun 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las// brgal nas sems nyid yid bzhin nor rnyed nas// rang gzhan 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las grol te// bde chen mchog gi go 'phang 'grub gyur cig /

bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa dzam bha lha'i khrid dngos grub char 'bebs zhes bya ba/ bla ma'i gsung las byon pa bzhin rnal 'byor pa 'od dpag rdo rjes yi ger bkod pa re zhig rdzogs so/// /dge'o// dge'o// dge'o//
